title: A Kitchen for the Tide
author: Xanthe Kavanagh
blurb: Vesper Fairweather, a cellist recovering from one catastrophic final performance, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade before the festival ends.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
